name: @freshcontext/core
description: FreshContext Core — the protocol-independent context-integrity engine: normalization, freshness and decay, ranking, utility, decisions, provenance primitives, source profiles, envelope and readable output. No MCP registration, no adapters, no network access, no storage.
comment: Not published. This package is the physical boundary inside the repository; the root build compiles it into ../../dist/core so the published freshcontext-mcp tarball stays self-contained and needs nothing from this workspace.
